params.name: option
params.description: Option number: one of the 'Print Options' theme constants (e.g. Paper option, Paper source option).

params.name: namesArray
params.description: Names of the values available for the specified option.

params.name: info1Array
params.description: Additional info (1) for each name, meaning depends on option (e.g. paper format heights).

params.name: info2Array
params.description: Additional info (2) for each name, meaning depends on option (e.g. paper format widths).

discriminatedBy.rule: The meaning of info1Array/info2Array depends on option: for Paper option (1), info1Array holds paper format heights and info2Array holds paper format widths; for Paper source option (5, Windows only), the arrays carry different option-specific info. To apply a value with SET PRINT OPTION, pass either the corresponding namesArray entry or its info1Array/info2Array counterparts.

constraints: Obtaining paper format information requires the print driver to have access to a valid PPD file for the printer.
Paper source option can only be used under Windows.
